$comment: One voice-ledger entry in a Voice-Aware Copyedit style sheet ([Project]_Style_Sheet.md). It records a form the author has kept (origin author) or the pass has inferred as possible voice (origin inferred), and the scope it holds over. book, chapter:N, paragraphs:a-b and instance:Pn.m are enforceable: copyedit.py E3 refuses an item that re-raises an author entry inside them. speaker:X and zone:Y are declared: they only label items, which must name the entry in ledger_refs. Increment 1 records `form` as a literal string. See docs/voice-aware-copyediting.md.
